title: The Honey Spoon for Two Pieces of Bread
youtube_title: The Honey Spoon for Two Pieces of Bread | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: What is split with care does not become less important.
summary: At a school cloakroom and the lunch mats just beyond, Anil sees that a honey spoon between two pieces of bread will not feel fair if only one person is served first. Anil makes a smaller, even share so Nils is included, and Uncle Idris lets the choice stand without a speech.
